tasks.label: Compilar y ejecutar regresiones JADE
tasks.command: set -e; JADE_JAR="../JADE-all-4.6.0/JADE-bin-4.6.0/jade/lib/jade.jar"; mkdir -p out; javac --release 25 -encoding UTF-8 -cp "$JADE_JAR" -d out $(find src/main/java -name '*.java'); java -cp "out:$JADE_JAR" regression.RegressionLauncher
